data.name: Dice Slinger
data.detailed_description:
DiceSlinger is dice poker game heavily focused on deck crafting and manipulating the dice to achieve highest scores possible. Enter the weird west world as an eldritch bounty hunter using specialized enchanted dice to catch his prey.

Challenge various characters and creatures in ever changing ways.

Polish your dice slinging skills with every challenge in a roguelike inspired by Balatro, spaghetti westerns and Lovecraft.

Expand your arsenal with tens of different unlockable dice styles.

Find powerful stratagem and dice combinations to conquer the weird west.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Features

Roguelike self contained runs

Unlock Based meta progression

Several Starting Decks favouring various playstyles

Unlockable higher levels of challenge

Accepting additional risky challenges for more rewards

Discover over 100 game changing stratagems

Customize your dice deck during runs to bend probabilities and physics to your will

Create your own synergies between stratagems and dice

Face rule bending Boss Bounties

Unlock over 40 different dice skins to flex on your opponents in style

Shiny math rocks go *click clack*
